deities.name: Thalunesh
deities.rationale: Shared route-memory, travel, and the ability to lend a remembered path align with passage and wanderers.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Asethyr
deities.rationale: Open-road freedom, communal wandering, and survival across steppe and badlands connect them to Asethyr.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: The preservation and transfer of sensory memories gives Nefarokir a secondary place in remembrance rites.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
